question: How is the least arity distributed under three declared weightings of connected homogeneous parity starts at positive reached ages?
public_inputs: Pointwise marked growing end and all marked bond minima through a given order. We compare strict later stages of the complete cheapest-count law.
forbidden_inputs: Do not pass physical junction rows to a reader except for the supplied growing end. They may certify which old permutations truly carry the span.
Do not discard a draw which stalls or exceeds a computation limit.
Do not pool weightings to estimate a single underlying probability.
weightings: Uniform labelled tree from a uniform Prüfer word.
Independent uniform labelled tree, then ceil((m-1)/4) distinct extra links drawn uniformly without replacement from non-tree pairs, capped at the available number.
Recursive tree where each new junction chooses one earlier junction uniformly; then uniformly relabel the whole tree.
loose_counts: max(0,3 minus ordinary degree) at every starting junction, one distinction for every ordinary link. Audit admissibility.
primary_observable: Least r with the pointwise end fixed, including r=0 and 1. An upper and lower certificate or an exact value per reached stage. Terminal stage has strict-future order zero. Report attrition by weighting, starting size and age; size frequencies by actual J and n.
cheapest_meaningful_control: Five-junction eleven-distinction reached witness fails on pairs and succeeds at a higher order; small labelled finite domains independently counted.
first_executable_signal: Check a reached sample against a lawful replay and a complete stabilizer or a sound structural containment proof.
resource_budget: 1,152 independent draws. Size caps on continued expansion preserve censored outcomes. Exhaust small sets, use certified bounds beyond exact tractability, run significant sweeps using the maintained batch runner.
decision_or_followup_rule: Compare distribution, spread, rate of exceptions and attachment predictors within weighting; identify whether extrapolating beyond observed sizes is justified.
stop_rule: Report all frozen samples and exact/genuine bounds, structural criterion and limits; no unrestricted asymptotic trend from finite samples.
